sloka: स त्वया निहतः पापो लीलया पुरुषर्षभ ।जगतश्च भयं तत्र प्रशान्तं तव तेजसा ।। ७.७१.८ ॥
transliteration: sa tvayā nihataḥ pāpo līlayā puruṣarṣabha ।jagataśca bhayaṁ tatra praśāntaṁ tava tejasā ।। 7.71.8 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, that wicked one was killed by you with ease, and the fear of the world was pacified by your valor.
